PBM.Note: Senior partner at PBM law firm.

Questions.Question: Who is on the Ark Fiduciaire team?
Questions.Answer: The team brings together four partners (Hassan Barbir, Samuel Halff, Rodrigue Sperisen and Lassana Dioum), a tax expert (Anthony Touboul), a project manager (Celeste Leal), a senior accountant (Sébastien Gallié), a team member (Catia Cardoso) and an office manager (Dima Ukbabe).

Questions.Question: Who runs the firm?
Questions.Answer: Samuel Halff, managing partner, runs the firm.

Questions.Question: Who handles tax?
Questions.Answer: Lassana Dioum is a partner and tax specialist, Anthony Touboul is a tax expert (personnel and compensation taxation, Swiss lump-sum taxation) and Rodrigue Sperisen specialises in international taxation and estates.

Questions.Question: Who handles foundations and trusts?
Questions.Answer: Hassan Barbir advises businesses and individuals, including foundations and trusts. Rodrigue Sperisen also handles trusts and inheritance matters.

Questions.Question: Who runs payroll and day-to-day accounting?
Questions.Answer: Sébastien Gallié, senior accountant and payroll manager, handles bookkeeping, monthly closings and reporting. Catia Cardoso and Dima Ukbabe support clients' day-to-day needs.

Questions.Question: Who is Lassana Dioum at Ark Fiduciaire?
Questions.Answer: Lassana Dioum is a partner and tax specialist at Ark Fiduciaire. He advises companies and individuals on direct and indirect taxation, supports accounting and tax compliance, and coordinates tax filings and rulings in several jurisdictions. He also serves as a director for international companies.

Questions.Question: Who is Samuel Halff?
Questions.Answer: Samuel Halff is managing partner of Ark Fiduciaire and runs the firm. He advises on accounting, tax, payroll and company law, sits as a director of international groups and sets up AI solutions to streamline processes and reporting.

Questions.Question: What is Samuel Halff's education?
Questions.Answer: He holds an LL.M. from UCLA and a master's in law from the University of Geneva, and has been admitted to the Geneva bar since 2013.

Questions.Question: Which languages does Samuel Halff speak?
Questions.Answer: Samuel Halff works in French, English and German.

Questions.Question: Who is Hassan Barbir?
Questions.Answer: Hassan Barbir is a partner at Ark Fiduciaire. He advises on accounting, tax, payroll and company law (formation, shareholdings and agreements) and sits as a director within international groups.

Questions.Question: What does Hassan Barbir work on?
Questions.Answer: He supports foundations and trusts, and handles tax matters and reorganisations.

Questions.Question: What is Hassan Barbir's background?
Questions.Answer: He holds an LL.M. in tax law, a master's and a bachelor's in law from the University of Geneva, and has been admitted to the Geneva bar since 2013. He speaks French, English and Italian, and is a member of ODAGE and the FSA.

Questions.Question: Who is Rodrigue Sperisen?
Questions.Answer: Rodrigue Sperisen is a partner at Ark Fiduciaire. He works in accounting, tax and company law, with a focus on international taxation.

Questions.Question: What is Rodrigue Sperisen's specialty?
Questions.Answer: He specialises in trusts and inheritance matters, and sets up clear governance and ownership frameworks.

Questions.Question: What are Rodrigue Sperisen's qualifications?
Questions.Answer: He holds a master's in law from the University of Neuchâtel, has been admitted to the Geneva bar since 2005 and holds the STEP diploma since 2009. He speaks French and English, and is a member of ODAGE, the FSA, OAR SFA-FSN, STEP, ASDS and the Art Law Foundation.

Questions.Question: Who is Lassana Dioum?
Questions.Answer: Lassana Dioum is a partner and tax specialist at Ark Fiduciaire. He advises businesses and individuals on direct and indirect taxation and acts as a director for international companies.

Questions.Question: What does Lassana Dioum do on tax?
Questions.Answer: He supports accounting and compliance from a tax angle and coordinates tax returns and tax rulings across several jurisdictions.

Questions.Question: What is Lassana Dioum's background?
Questions.Answer: He holds a master's in business law, a bachelor's in law and HEC training from the University of Geneva, and has been admitted to the Geneva bar since 2012. He speaks French, English and Spanish, and is a member of ODAGE, the FSA, the IBA, the IFA and AIJA.

Questions.Question: Who is Anthony Touboul?
Questions.Answer: Anthony Touboul is a tax expert at Ark Fiduciaire. He supports compliance for companies and individuals and sits as a director for local and international companies.

Questions.Question: Which tax topics does Anthony Touboul cover?
Questions.Answer: He specialises in personnel and compensation taxation and in Swiss lump-sum taxation.

Questions.Question: What is Anthony Touboul's education?
Questions.Answer: He holds an LL.M. in tax law from the University of Geneva (2011 to 2013) and a master's in business law and taxation (DJCE) from Université Jean Moulin Lyon III (2004 to 2006).

Questions.Question: Who is Celeste Leal?
Questions.Answer: Celeste Leal is a project manager at Ark Fiduciaire.

Questions.Question: What does Celeste Leal do at the firm?
Questions.Answer: She leads client and internal projects, supports the team and makes sure delivery runs smoothly.

Questions.Question: How do I contact Celeste Leal?
Questions.Answer: The easiest way is to email info@ark-fid.ch or use the contact page on the site. We usually reply within 24 hours.

Questions.Question: Who is Sébastien Gallié?
Questions.Answer: Sébastien Gallié is a senior accountant and payroll manager at Ark Fiduciaire.

Questions.Question: What does Sébastien Gallié do day to day?
Questions.Answer: He handles bookkeeping, monthly closings and reporting, and makes sure the figures are reliable and the deliverables arrive on time.

Questions.Question: What is Sébastien Gallié's education?
Questions.Answer: He holds the federal fiduciary agent certificate (2018 to 2021) and the federal diploma of fiduciary expert (2022 to 2025).

Questions.Question: Who is Catia Cardoso?
Questions.Answer: Catia Cardoso is a team member in administrative and accounting operations at Ark Fiduciaire.

Questions.Question: What does Catia Cardoso do at the firm?
Questions.Answer: She supports the day-to-day follow-up of client needs.

Questions.Question: How do I contact Catia Cardoso?
Questions.Answer: The easiest way is to email info@ark-fid.ch or use the contact page on the site. We usually reply within 24 hours.

Questions.Answer: Dima Ukbabe is an office manager at Ark Fiduciaire.
